Alex P: heads up — after the 535.102 driver push to staging we started seeing an unexpected kernel ranking change on H100 hosts. latency tails up ~18% for 1k seq workloads.
Maya R: ugh. did autotuner pick a different GEMM kernel or is this a scheduling shift?
Alex P: autotuner report attached (see below). It selected a different matmul kernel for large sequence lengths — preference changed from cuBLAS-XT-like to our fallback JIT kernel for some layers.
Kevin L: can you paste the profiler flame? I want to see where the extra cycles are.
Alex P: paste: ```
# perf sample (summary)
layer_8_gemm  -> 42.1%  (was 28.3% pre-patch)
kv_cache_apply -> 8.2% (unchanged)
softmax_opt -> 6.5% (small)
batch_aggregate overhead -> 3.9% (was 1.1%)
```
Maya R: batch aggregator spiking is interesting — might be due to sequence-length-specific tiled kernel causing more fragmentation in our continuous batching heuristic.
Kevin L: did the autotuner input profile change? maybe new microbenchmarks exposed different throughput for single-op but worse end-to-end when fused with KV cache ops.
Alex P: autotuner trace excerpt: ```
{"device":"H100","seq_len":1024,"micro_throughput":9000,"end2end_sim":7200,"kernel_choice":"jit_fused_2025_v3"}
{"device":"H100","seq_len":512,"micro_throughput":11000,"end2end_sim":10800,"kernel_choice":"cublas_win_fast"}
```
Maya R: note that end2end_sim dropped for 1024 despite micro throughput being decent. That's the signature of KV cache memory behavior + increased memcpy/strided GEMM overhead.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2025.03.14-driver-535.102 completed on staging at 2025-03-14T18:12:02Z :rocket:
Alex P: Can confirm repro on staging w/ a synthetic workload that exercises long contexts + cache hits.
Kevin L: immediate mitigation options: (1) pin kernel whitelist for H100 in runtime agent, (2) force-disable autotuner for seq_len >= 768, (3) fall back to previous driver on H100 nodes.
Maya R: I'd prefer (1) + (2) so we don't need infra rollback. Which kernels to whitelist? the previous good set was `cublas_win_fast` + `fused_kv_opt_v2`.
Alex P: Agree. I'll prepare a canary that forces kernel_set=["cublas_win_fast","fused_kv_opt_v2"] for the canary pool.
Kevin L: also add a runtime flag `runtime.autotune.disable_for_seq_ge=768` and gate it behind a remote config so we can flip quickly.
Alex P: working on PR: ```yaml
# runtime override snippet
kernel_whitelist:
  H100: ["cublas_win_fast","fused_kv_opt_v2"]
autotune_overrides:
  H100:
    seq_len_min: 768
    enabled: false
```
Maya R: good. let's roll to 5% of staging first. Watch token-per-second and tail-latency.
deploy-bot: Rolling config canary to staging (pool: h100-canary) — 5% — started.
Alex P: can we add perf counters to the canary: tensorcore_util, memcpy_bytes, batch_coalesce_rate?
Kevin L: yes, I'll add tracing hooks to console dashboard.
sre-oncall: FYI — if rollback to driver is needed, we need a 2-hour maintenance window for H100 fleet and coordinate with cloud infra. Prefer software mitigations first.
Maya R: agreed. let's wait for canary metrics. If tail latency doesn't improve within 30m, escalate to plan B (driver rollback).
Alex P: initial canary numbers (10m): tail P99 latency down 12% vs bad baseline, tensorcore_util stable, memcpy_bytes down 30% on canary. Looks promising.
Kevin L: nice. keep it running 45m then widen to 25% if stable.
Alex P: after 50m canary we widened to 25% and saw consistent improvement. I'm going to cut a short postmortem note after we finish.
Maya R: action items: 1) Alex cut perf PR + revertable runtime whitelist (done in canary) 2) Kevin add dashboard KPIs + alerts for seq>=768 path 3) Ops keep driver rollback playbook updated (sre-oncall)
sre-oncall: noted, I'll update the runbook with estimated downtime and the exact node image tag to revert to.
Alex P: thanks all. follow-up: we should add a mandatory autotune end-to-end sim step (simulate KV cache + batching) before accepting kernel swaps. Filing an infra-ticket now. :spiral_note_pad:
Kevin L: +1 on the sim step. It would have caught this.
Maya R: saved a heap of infra churn — nice work. :party_parrot:
